title: Structured character language competence and word-level lexicon replacing dead capabilities.languages

sections.what: Replace the dead capabilities.languages id-list in engine/character_appearance.py with structured per-language competence and exact known_words lexicon records ({language, fluency, known_words, literate}), compile and round-trip them onto Player, and expose them in the Persona inspector UI.
sections.why: CAPABILITIES_FIELDS in engine/character_appearance.py (line 158) declares languages as an idlist and CONSUMER_HINTS advertises it for communication, yet compile_record() (lines 1181-1285) ignores capabilities.languages completely and 0 runtime readers exist. As established in task-733 ('Folded deltas 2026-10-18', superseding task-869) and docs/design/person-data-model.md section 5.4, a language is not a numeric skill, and settings such as a goblin camp or a Japanese high school with an exchange student require knowing exact known_words per foreign language rather than just a label.
sections.how:
1. Define normalized language schema helpers in engine/character_appearance.py supporting {language, fluency, known_words, literate} (validating fluency in native/fluent/conversational/broken/none and normalizing legacy string tags like 'common' into fluent/native defaults).
2. Wire compile_record() in engine/character_appearance.py and apply_node_properties()/to_node_properties() in engine/character_store.py (plus DEFINITION_FIELDS in engine/character_record.py and engine/serialization.py) so languages compile onto Player and round-trip cleanly instead of being dropped.
3. Update /api/players/<name>/record routes in routes/player_ops.py and replace the flat _PERSONA_ID_LISTS languages editor in static/js/inspector/persona-view.ts with a structured per-language row editor (language id, fluency select, literate toggle, known_words chip/tag list).
sections.verify:
1. Run pytest covering structured language schema validation, compile_record(), character_store hydration, and save/load round-trip serialization.
2. Run npm run build:ts and verify Persona tab Languages editing, Save, Compile, and reload in Browser UI.

acceptance.text: capabilities.languages accepts structured {language, fluency, known_words, literate} entries (with legacy string-item normalization) and survives compile_record().
Player stores and round-trips structured languages across engine/character_store.py and engine/serialization.py without creating a duplicate persisted copy.
Persona inspector tab renders and saves language fluency, literate flag, and exact known_words lexicon cleanly via /record and /record/compile.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Character Inspector -> Mind -> Persona tab -> Capabilities -> Languages.

Current availability: static/js/inspector/persona-view.ts (line 51) renders languages as a flat _PERSONA_ID_LISTS pill input and engine/character_appearance.py compile_record() drops capabilities.languages completely.

Manual verification steps:
1. Open a character in Character Inspector -> Mind -> Persona -> Capabilities.
   - expected: Languages shows structured rows with language name, fluency selector (native/fluent/conversational/broken/none), literate toggle, and known_words token list.
2. Add English with fluency='broken', literate=false, and known_words=['bathroom', 'wait', 'hungry'], Save and Compile, then reload the scenario.
   - expected: GET /api/players/<name>/record and scenario save/load preserve the exact fluency and known_words lexicon.
